title: When pianos arrived and six-piece dance bands
summary: Pianos came late, around when drums did, and the dance bands he played with were six pieces without piano.

story.theme_name: Pianists: who played, who influenced whom
story.community_name: Who played piano: the pianists musicians remembered

blocks.x: When did the pianos start getting popular?
Well that was late, late after that, late after that. Pianos start at the same time with the drum.
They have many piano players around here?

Well let's see, no, they had a few, not too many. I know for the old generation they used to play piano. But uh, but uh, but... That place I played, they didn't have no pianos at all. No, they didn't have no pianos I'm telling, they didn't have no pianos at all. They used nothing but the bass, guitar, trumpet, crown bone and clarinet. That's all. Six pieces.
Sometimes a fiddle huh? Some bands had fiddle. Well that's what I thought. But I never played with no fiddle.
Some didn't have no fiddle, some didn't have no fiddle. Some didn't have a band or two, you know, some didn't have a band.
